improved strains of recombinants of E. coli were isolated for ethanol production from mixtures of hexoses and pentoses.
improved strains of ethanologen E. coli have been developed for the fermentation of sugar mixtures containing both hexoses and pentoses.

developing improved ethanologens for fermentation of hemicellulose sugars to ethanol.
the development of E. coli strains that can produce ethanol from sugar mixtures, including those containing xylose, and the development of fermentation processes that can utilize these strains.

the new strains of ethanologen E. coli are superior in their ability to produce ethanol from sugar mixtures and that the two-step fermentation is a viable approach to the conversion of pentose sugars to fuels.

the fermentation of pentose sugars in sugar mixtures is feasible with improved ethanologgenic E. coli strains.
